title: How a Godly Man Wins the Fight Nobody Sees Him Fight
caption:
He doesn't lose to the whole failure. He loses to the five seconds before it, when nobody's checking and the yes feels small.

That's where a godly man actually fights. Not in the aftermath, in the window right before it: the extra tab, the second plate, the reply he shouldn't send. Put something slower between yourself and the yes. Tell a brother what your five seconds usually look like, before you're back in them.

Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh (Galatians 5:16). The win isn't dramatic. It's five seconds, repeated.

Save this for the next time it's just you and the five seconds.

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
